bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Wednesday) the track is rated a good 4 but with light rain forecast tomorrow there's the chance of a downgrade. DEMARCAY will find this easier than the metro races he's contested at his past couple and was only narrowly denied over this route three back. SUNNY DISPOSITION also drops in grade and had been holding form well prior. FLAMING GENESIS has been sound at both runs back from a break and strips all the fitter for them. PAPAL MISS was never likely on synthetic last time but tried hard behind a dominant victor on turf the start prior.

raceTips.comment: DEMARCAY drops sharply in grade. He went down by only the barest of margins over this track and trip three runs back and with the 4kg claim, he’ll take beating. SUNNY DISPOSITION got the better of Demarcay here last month but she did have a 7kg weight pull on that occasion. Hard fit, she drops back from metro grade and can certainly figure. SEALORD was s dominant winner at the Gold Coast two runs back but failed to fire at Toowoomba last time. He’s yet to step out past 2050m but I think the rise in journey will suit. FLAMING GENESIS hasn’t been far away in his two starts this campaign. He strips fitter and the step up in trip should suit.

bestBets.overview: MAGRITTE was game in defeat in town first up last prep and has contested much tougher races than this in her career. She comfortably won a recent Warwick trial and must be kept very safe. The debutante I'M NOT HERE has won her past two trials at Doomben and draws well. ELNAJEEB was game in defeat fresh and is likely to press forward from the wide draw and be in it for a long way. KIAVELA was sound holding fourth position throughout fresh and will only be improved.

raceTips.comment: MAGRITTE returns to the races. Stakes placed at two, she holds solid form around her and looks ready to fire off a recent trial win. She gets in beautifully after the claim and draws to get the right run. I’M NOT HERE debuts. She lines up here off two Doomben trial wins and with the inside draw, she’ll take catching. ZOUBUCA SHOTS resumes. She looked good winning a recent Deagon trial, the blinkers go on and she draws to get the right run. FAWUNDERPAW didn’t have a lot of luck when last start over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast but found the line well. The rise in trip looks ideal.

bestBets.overview: NAUGHTY NURSE was confidently backed and found the line well at the Sunshine Coast. She's also accepted at Doomben on Saturday and must be respected if lining up here instead. DETRIMENTAL disappointed second up, then stuck on soundly after facing the breeze last time. DIVIL A BIT is holding form well and there's no reason to think that he can't play a role in the finish again. TARAVIA has tuned up for this with a Deagon trial placing and may find 1650m suitable while new.

raceTips.comment: DETRIMENTAL drops back to country level and at peak fitness, the step to 1600m looks ideal. He has won at his only start here and he draws to get the right run. MISHANI WITNESS comes off a strong win over the mile at Ipswich. He too is one from one at this track but he will need luck, as he does get back. EMPIRE OF ART closed off strongly to finish a length away in fourth when resuming at Doomben. He strips fitter and should find this easier. DIVIL A BIT has won two of his past three starts. Hard fit, he has a great record at the mile and will be right in this.

SEQUEL has the speed to lead these up and will appreciate the drop in grade having been found wanting late behind Grinzinger Champ at her past couple.

raceTips.comment: SEQUEL scored a strong win over this track and trip three starts back and hasn’t been far away in two subsequent runs in stronger company. Back in grade, and if she can cross without burning too much petrol early, she’ll take beating. IMMEDIATE continues to race well. The 1200m appears to be her pet trip but she will need luck from the wide gate. BARRELLING resumes. He’s yet to figure in three first up appearances but the form around him is solid and he gets in well with the 4kg claim. STRAIGHT BLAST proved too good when resuming over 1200m at Dalby. He strips fitter, the claim sees him in nicely and he draws to get the right run.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian mare LANE CHANGER was a noted drifter in betting but worked home okay from the rear over 1100m at her local debut. She'll be better for it, the rise in trip suits and she can't be taken lightly this time. Former NSW gelding EXCEED PERFECTION failed to finish off second up but wasn't far away when resuming and is right in this on his best form. MISS BOUNDARIES wasn't disgraced at huge odds in town last time. INVISIBLE TARGET draws poorly but is overdue another win.

raceTips.comment: It’s been a long time between drinks for EXCEED PERFECTION but he looks well placed to break his runs of outs. At peak fitness, he drops down in class and the low draw should see him afforded every chance. LANE CHANGER was safely held when kicking off for the new stable but she will have taken improvement from the outing. The rise in trip suits and she draws to get the right run. It was a solid effort from MISSING BOUNDARIES when stepping up to metro class last start. Back in grade and in trip, she can figure. INVISIBLE TARGET is racing well but will need luck from the wide draw.

bestBets.overview: FIERCE LUVA hit the line hard to just miss fresh, then tried hard but was no match for the victor second up. He should be peaking now and has strong claims to go one better. LAMBERTINA is holding form well and should be paying a role in the finish again. The on-pacer SPEED MAP has battled away soundly at both outings since leading throughout second up and should be in it for a long way. SNUGG hit the line hard when resuming and has worked home okay without threat at both subsequent runs.

raceTips.comment: MONAKEED settled back the tail and was good through the line when resuming at the Sunshine Coast. Fitter, she drops back in grade and the rise to 1400m looks ideal. SILVER SMASH comes out of that same Sunshine Coast race where she finished second. The rise in trip is a slight query but any rain brings her right into contention. FIERCE LUVA steps out for the new stable. With a win and two second placings from just the three starts, he looks progressive and the 1400m suits. LAMBERTINA is hard fit and racing well. She has won over this track and trip previously and must be included.
